The only production callers of `VisitService.saveVisit` in the REST module are in `VisitResource1_9` and `VisitAttributeResource1_9`. Two test methods also call it directly. I found these with Falkon's symbol references plus a text search for `saveVisit|VisitService`, which surfaced no other call sites.

1. **`VisitResource1_9.save`** (line 253) is the main one. It is the `DelegatingCrudResource.save` override, so any change to `saveVisit` affects REST create and update of visits.
2. **`VisitAttributeResource1_9.save`** (lines 114 and 97–116) calls `saveVisit(delegate.getVisit())` after adding or replacing the attribute on the visit.
3. **`VisitAttributeResource1_9.delete`** (line 126) calls `saveVisit` after voiding an attribute, so a change would affect attribute deletion.
4. **`VisitController1_9Test`** (line 277) calls `saveVisit` directly to set up a visit with an extra encounter for the edit test.
5. **`EncounterController1_9Test`** (line 359) calls `saveVisit` directly to create a visit for the encounter-edit test.

The core declarations for reference are `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/VisitService.java:222` and `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/VisitServiceImpl.java:178` in openmrs-core. The rest of the REST module only uses other `VisitService` methods.
